keys: Where tradition meets craft. Handpulled noodles, timeless recipes, and flavors passed down through generations.

groups.title: Our Story
keys: Crafting authentic flavors since the very beginning
At Noodle Inn, every dish tells a story. Our recipes are rooted in centuries-old culinary traditions, brought to life with the freshest ingredients and an unwavering dedication to craft.

Our noodles are hand-pulled daily by skilled artisans, a mesmerizing process that transforms simple dough into silky strands of perfection. Each bowl is a labor of love, prepared with techniques passed down through generations.
From the warmth of our kitchen to your table, we invite you to experience the soul of Chinese cuisine — where every bite is a journey and every meal is a celebration.

groups.title: Footer
keys: Authentic Chinese cuisine crafted with passion. Hand-pulled noodles and timeless flavors since day one.

Crafting authentic flavors since the ver.en: One of the city's longest established Chinese restaurants
Crafting authentic flavors since the ver.zh: 本市歷史最悠久的中餐館之一

At Noodle Inn, every dish tells a story..en: Noodle Inn (London Road) was established in 2004 and became one of Sheffield's oldest Chinese restaurants. Over the years, the management at Noodle Inn combined traditional Chinese cuisine with modern trends to serve the local Chinese community. With a focus on Cantonese cuisine, the emphasis remains on both quality and quantity. Aside from wok-fried dishes, our signature 'big plate rice' and 'big bowl noodles' have taken the city by storm. The trend was set and other restaurants followed suit. Our three roasties are made fresh every day and are a must-try for all customers.
At Noodle Inn, every dish tells a story..zh: 麵軒（倫敦路店）成立於2004年，是謝菲爾德市遠近馳名的中餐館。成立二十多年來，麵軒人致力於把傳統中餐與現代需要結合起來，以更好地服務於華人社區。麵軒以粵菜為主，尤其註重菜品質量與分量並重。除了炒菜以外，量大美味的大碟飯、大碗麵和大碟麵更成為麵軒的一大特色，引發同類餐館紛紛仿效；而明爐三燒則是麵軒一絕。

Our noodles are hand-pulled daily by ski.en: In 2010, to serve the demand and palates of our inbound Chinese students, we established our range of Sichuan cuisine, hiring an expert from China to serve authentic food. This was well received by our Chinese customers and deepened our local customers' appreciation of the diversity of Chinese cuisine, promoting Chinese food culture and bringing the foremost advances to Sheffield. In 2011, we added Dim Sum, a fundamental part of Cantonese cuisine, carefully selecting the finest offerings. Since then our menu has expanded further (over 200 dishes), each with its own speciality to suit every need.
Our noodles are hand-pulled daily by ski.zh: 在2010年，為滿足日益增多的中國留學生飲食需要，我們決定引入川菜，並專門高薪聘請川菜名廚主理。此舉不僅贏得廣大中國同胞的肯定，也使更多西方人認識到中餐的多樣性，為弘揚中國博大精深的飲食文化做出了貢獻。在2011年，我們新增了粵式點心，精致美味的點心是粵菜文化不可或缺的一部分，我們精心選擇點心中的精華菜式，獻給所有熱愛美食的人們。從此，我們的菜品不僅多樣化（多達200道），而且富有自己的特色。

From the warmth of our kitchen to your t.en: Over the past decade our vision has remained the same: maintain the high quality of food and bespoke customer service to win over customers of all backgrounds and preferences. We continue to put customers first, working hard and constantly innovating our menu. Noodle Inn welcomes you!
From the warmth of our kitchen to your t.zh: 二十多年來我們始終如一，以高質素的菜品和服務，贏得不同文化背景顧客的喜愛與信任。我們始終堅持以顧客需要為優先的原則，不斷創新，不斷努力。麵軒歡迎您！
